name: Kaci Foxx Avenging Angel
detailed_description:
Kaci Foxx: Avenging Angel is a story driven action-adventure RPG with haunting choices and exciting combat.

“Will you choose Mercy … or Revenge? What will your choice cost you?”

Become a warrior. Step into the shoes of Kaci Foxx, a fierce warrior driven by vengeance after a tragic loss which nearly destroyed her.

Travel to exotic lands. With her heart hardened and skills honed, she embarks on a perilous journey through treacherous landscapes.

Battle Monsters. Kaci, and her extraordinary canine companion, Ember, will face formidable foes and uncover dark secrets as they struggle to survive insurmountable odds.

Hunt the ultimate evil. As she hunts down the man responsible for her suffering, Kaci grapples with her inner demons—each battle pushing her closer to the edge. Will she sacrifice her humanity for revenge, or can she reclaim her lost soul?

Face difficult choices. In this gripping tale of resilience and redemption, players must navigate Kaci’s tumultuous path toward justice and face impossibly difficult choices. Will you choose mercy? Or will you risk becoming the monster you hunt by choosing vengeance?

short_description: Kaci Foxx is a comic inspired action-RPG. As a powerful warrior & champion for the innocent, you travel to exotic lands, battle formidable foes, & seek revenge on the ultimate evil who nearly destroyed you. Will you choose mercy... or revenge? What will your choice cost you?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-6700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 5700 or Intel® Arc™ A750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on minimum requirements should enable to play on Low/Medium quality settings in FullHD (1080p) in stable 30 FPS. SSD is recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K | AMD Ryzen 5 3600X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® 2080RTX or AMD Radeon™ 6800XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device.
  • Additional Notes: Playing on recommended requirements should enable to play on medium quality settings in 120 FPS and high-quality settings in 60 FPS or higher in FullHD (or 4k using DLSS or similar technology). SSD is recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: This game deals with some dark moral choices, mature emotions such as death and loss, and some evil characters with dark psychology which may be disturbing for young players or sensitive individuals.
